description: This Python module provides utilities for creating and configuring Daily video conferencing rooms and tokens, including support for SIP integration and environment variable configurations.

classes.name: DailyRoomConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a Daily room, including URL, token, and optional SIP endpoint.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or retrieves a Daily room and token, supporting SIP configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: configure_with_args
methods.description: Deprecated function for configuring a Daily room with command-line arguments; now recommends using 'configure'.
